mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_learning_record (user_id, type, topic, duration_minutes, source_id, remark, client_record_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{topic}, #{durationMinutes}, #{sourceId}, #{remark}, #{clientRecordId}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, topic, duration_minutes, source_id, remark, client_record_id, create_time FROM sa_learning_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND client_record_id = #{clientRecordId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, type, topic, duration_minutes, source_id, remark, create_time FROM sa_learning_record WHERE ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
